summary: Concrete lighthouse on the southern tip of Kuiu Island, Alaska: the last staffed light built in the territory and its first electric one, lit in 1932.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Record's 23.0 m tower matches LighthouseFriends/Society '75 feet' overall height; NRHP gives tower 40 ft above the roof and Bulletin a three-storey tower. Different measures (overall vs tower above roof), not an error.

notes_for_editor: Evanson's fate after 24 Dec 1935 not found (no later page searched beyond two Alaska Empire pages). The 1932 Bulletin page is two-column OCR with interleaved lines; quotes were taken from fragments that read contiguously; dimensions conflict with NRHP (tower, cost, one vs two tyfons) and are stated as conflicts in the text. The Society website lists 'Francis Edward Craig's journal' but the page text was empty when fetched. Coast Guard roster 1959-66 per USLHS while LighthouseFriends says live-in crews until Sept 1974: gap not explained. NRHP says 'Lighthouse Board' in 1929 though the Lighthouse Service existed; ignored. NRHP listing year 2005 from LighthouseFriends only (nomination signature date illegible in OCR). LighthouseFriends is copyrighted; paraphrased with one short quote. Evanson is not the same person as the unrelated 'Evenson' hits in Bulletins.
